title: SimpleJumpPads (SJP)
description: Simple and feature packed jump pads plugin for your server!
body:
![A text of SimpleJumpPads with green, yellow, blud gradient.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0c04c9dc866dc3bba5bdf5ac8a21cbba980a3bbd.png)

---

Welcome to **S**imple**J**ump**P**ads! SJP provide a simple and feature packed jumppads for your Minecraft server.

Check out the feature list below!

# Features

- **Sound & Particle** - Add sound & particle to each jump pads
- **Location Based** - Only active jump pads in a location
- **Specific Material** - Only active jump pads when player step on the correct material, even AIR!
- **Flexible Direction** - Cardinal directions, up, down, custom angle and player direction
- **Horizontal & Vertical Boost** - Custom boost value for each separately
- **Target Location** - Add jump pads by either using your target block or your location

## You may also like...

- [SimpleJoinMessage](https://modrinth.com/plugin/sjm) - A simple plugin to send message when player
  join w/ MiniMessage and PlaceholderAPI supported!
- [SimpleScoreBoard](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simplescoreboard) - A really simple scoreboard plugin, just for the simplicity.

## Metrics
SimpleJumpPads use [bStats](https://bstats.org/plugin/bukkit/TheSimpleJumpPads/31959) to collect metrics. [What is bStats?](https://bstats.org/docs/server-owners)
